style: Warm paper palette with exact fraction diagrams and a cut-paper activity illustration
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: All artwork is text-free. Use each native caption to identify endpoints: single-whole diagrams run from 0 at the left tall tick to 1 at the right tall tick. In two-whole diagrams the middle tall tick is 1 and the right tall tick is 2. Small arrowheads show that the number line continues; they are not additional fraction ticks. Colored strip parts match the marked location. A denominator counts equal intervals in one whole, not tick marks. Each sort card uses the same unit length; infer its category from the fraction rather than a category color. The materials illustration is preparation, not a completed or measured model. Use a marked measuring tool for the activity; the pictured unmarked straightedge only helps draw straight lines. Student diagrams should include editable numerical labels. Educator review is still needed.

sources.prompt: Create a square educational cut-paper collage, warm cream background, tactile handmade paper edges, restrained teal, ochre and coral colors. Subject is preparing a measured paper-strip number-line activity: a long straight blank cream paper strip laid horizontally across a tabletop, a plain wooden straightedge with NO markings alongside it, a small roll of teal painter's tape and a few blank coral index cards near the strip, a pencil beside the straightedge. Carefully arranged overhead still life focused on measurement tools and the strip. No people. No text, letters, numbers, symbols, tick marks or fractional partitions anywhere. Do not imply this is a completed number line: it is materials before measuring and marking. Elegant spacious editorial paper craft illustration, not a photograph or 3D render.
sources.alt: A blank paper strip lies above an unmarked wooden straightedge; a pencil, teal tape roll and blank coral cards sit nearby in a paper collage.
